remotion.compatibility: Frame/fps, exact version parity for all Remotion packages

svg.use: Diagrams, vector artwork, current paths and lightweight effects
svg.compatibility: React DOM and SVG driven by Remotion frames

three.use: Spatial relationships, mechanical motion and technical cutaways
three.compatibility: ThreeCanvas; use Remotion frame, WebGL only in the applicable shot

footage.compatibility: Existing FFmpeg preparation, rights metadata and safe slots

formula.compatibility: Existing SVG formula catalog and karaoke timestamps

rough.compatibility: Seed sketches and render SVG within Remotion

flubber.use: Morph dissimilar SVG paths when interpolation is insufficient
flubber.compatibility: Seek by passing Remotion progress to the interpolator

zdog.use: Lightweight pseudo-3D when parallax or existing Three objects do not fit

particles.use: Complex particle fields exceeding seeded SVG helpers
particles.compatibility: Deterministic stepping and repeatable seeks; verify before integration

lottie.compatibility: Disable autoplay and seek to exact frame

theatre.compatibility: Studio for authoring only; seek sequence position from frame/fps

fluid.use: Decorative or validated fluid effects when SVG smoke is insufficient
fluid.compatibility: No autonomous GPU clock; requires deterministic bake or stepping

hydra.use: Procedural abstract shader when inline shaders are insufficient
hydra.compatibility: Supply deterministic time and seed or bake before import

lygia.use: Reuse required GLSL routines for advanced shading
lygia.compatibility: Pin shader files and bind uniforms from frame

gsap.use: Seekable complex timeline when Remotion interpolation is insufficient
gsap.compatibility: Paused timeline with explicit time; check license terms

anime.use: Seekable vector sequencing when native effects are insufficient

motion-canvas.use: Complicated diagrams or mathematical scenes with demonstrated benefit
motion-canvas.compatibility: Separate project, deterministic media export into Remotion
